name: Weekly Volatility-Scaled Portfolio (SPY/TLT/GLD/DBC)
description: Inverse-volatility weighted portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC. Weights are computed weekly using 60-day realized volatility (rolling std of returns). Rebalances every Monday. Long-only, fully invested — weights sum to 100%. No stop loss or take profit; the strategy relies on diversification and vol-scaling for risk management.
source:
# Weekly Volatility-Scaled Portfolio — SPY, TLT, GLD, DBC
# Inverse-volatility weighting: lower-vol assets receive higher allocations
# Vol estimated as 60-day rolling realized volatility (annualized std of returns)
# Rebalances every Monday; always fully invested (weights sum to 100%)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Volatility Estimation ---
# volatility() takes price levels directly (S47: do NOT pre-compute returns)
# Output is annualized decimal vol (e.g., 0.15 = 15% annualized)
vol_60d = volatility(period=60)(close)

# --- Rebalance Trigger ---
# Fire on the first trading bar of each week (Monday or next available day)
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week, boundary=BoundaryType.start)(index())

# --- Inverse-Volatility Weights ---
# All 4 assets are always active (long-only, fully invested)
# inv_vol_weight cross-sectionally assigns w_i = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j)
# min_volatility=0.05 prevents any single asset from dominating during low-vol regimes
always_active = is_valid(vol_60d)   # True once 60-day warmup is complete
weights = inv_vol_weight(min_volatility=0.05)(active_mask=always_active, volatility=vol_60d)

# --- Execution ---
# Always long; entry fires once warmup is complete, never exits
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=always_active)

# Size as percent of equity using inverse-vol weight, rebalance weekly
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights.weight * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_week)
